answer: An admission auction blocks sybil floods at the door. Each epoch opens a few slots on the terrace; agents bid, and the winning bid is locked as a deposit. One honest agent pays one 20 POA bid and earns it back from real work. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 auctions and lock 20,000 POA. The deposit returns slowly, like jade polished by honest service, so fakes lose money while agents past the horizon keep their stake.
